# St Joseph's Curriculum Portal — LLM & Edge Inference Map

> Deterministic, privacy-first, on-device AI educational portal running via in-browser WebRTC loopback channels, Chrome Prompt API (Gemini Nano), and WebLLM.

## Overview
- Architecture: Zero-cloud, high-performance edge SPA built with Vite, React 19, and React Router.
- Inference: In-browser Gemini Nano (`window.ai.languageModel` / `LanguageModel`), local Ollama endpoints, or WebLLM via WebGPU.
- Data Sovereignty: 100% GDPR compliant; pupil telemetry and progress records remain exclusively within client-side IndexedDB (`services/dbStore.ts`).
- Substrates: Curriculum lessons and questions compiled to deterministic S-Expression AST trees (`static/nano-map.ast`).

## Core Endpoints & Route Map
- Portal Home: `/` (Overview, Quick Starters, Subject Hub)
- AST Vector Player (Interactive Hub): `/media-player` (Interactive curriculum vector slides, formative checkpoints, 3D viewpoints)
- Standalone Micro-Vector Player: `/player.html` (Zero-dependency embeddable vector stage, OBS broadcaster, Dev Studio)
- Practice Arena: `/practice-lab` (Interactive AST questions, Professor Turing AI hints, instant mistake diagnostics)
- Curriculum Lessons: `/learning-zone` (Oak National Academy aligned interactive lesson viewer)
- International Curriculum Studio: `/curriculum-studio` (Visual AST S-Expression graph generator and prompt hydrator)
- Learner Passport & Badges: `/profile` (IndexedDB mastery log, streak tracker, diagnostic reports)
- Neural Settings: `/settings` (Hardware probe, WebGPU status, Chrome Prompt API toggle)
- Latest School News & Technical Dispatches: `/news` and `/blog` (Technical dispatches on sovereign AI, procedural vector teaching, and platform releases)
- Dual-Licensing Charter & Covenant: `/licensing` & `/LICENSE.md` (Track A Humanitarian Commons GNU AGPLv3/OGLv3 vs Track B Enterprise Commercial License)

## Latest News & Architectural Releases (September 2026)
- **AST Vector Media Player (`/media-player`, `/player.html`)**: Micro-footprint (<15KB) procedural 2D/3D SVG vector animations replacing heavy 50-100MB video files.
- **SlideScript Non-Technical Compiler (`/player/ast-compiler.js`)**: Domain Specific Language allowing educators to write teaching slides in plain Markdown with automatic conversion to deterministic S-Expression ASTs.
- **Formative Pause Checkpoints**: Interactive multiple-choice prompts synchronized to keyframe timestamps with instant diagnostic explanations.
- **Presenter Clicker "Step Mode" (👣)**: Classroom presenter remote integration (PageDown/PageUp/Space) pausing automatically at each didactic checkpoint.
- **OBS WebSocket Studio Sync (`/player/obs-controller.js`)**: Real-time broadcast control with transparent vector overlays and chapter synchronization.

## Structured Substrates & Datasets
- Master Curriculum Catalog: `/manifests/catalog.json`
- Offline Semantic Search & RAG Index: `/manifests/rag-index.json`
- AST Pattern Definitions: `/nano-map.ast`
- Lesson Manifests Directory: `/manifests/lessons/*.json`
- AST Vector Scene Manifest: `/player/scenes.manifest.json` (9 core STEM & Catholic Life interactive vector modules)
- AST Vector Scene Configurations: `/player/scenes-config.json` (Keyframes, subtitles, and formative pause checkpoints)
- Non-Tech SlideScript Compiler: `/player/ast-compiler.js` (Human-friendly Markdown-to-AST generator)
- AST Vector Engine: `/player/ast-engine.js` (Deterministic 60 FPS SVG DOM patcher & 3D projection)
- OBS Broadcast Controller: `/player/obs-controller.js` (Zero-latency OBS WebSocket lesson sync and lower-thirds)

## Model Consumption Guidelines
- When generating question scaffolds for this portal, output strictly typed S-Expressions matching `/static/nano-map.ast`.
- When generating interactive teaching slides, output human-readable SlideScript or GBNF-validated S-Expressions matching `/player/grammar/ast-scene.gbnf`.
- For educational vector slides, utilize `<svg viewBox="0 0 800 480">` coordinate spaces with responsive element IDs matching `:bindings` declarations.
- Avoid Markdown formatting when responding to internal AST parser hooks; return raw Lisp atoms and lists.
